children: La Rosa Holdings entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor to issue 200 shares of Series E Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share. The transaction closed on September 15, 2026, generating $200,000 in gross proceeds. The investor also obtained an option, subject to conditions, to purchase additional Series E Preferred shares at the stated value in one or more additional closings. The deal is intended to provide additional capital flexibility.
: Securities Purchase Agreement for Series E Convertible Preferred Stock
: Raise capital for general corporate purposes
